speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me your age and any relevant medical history, as your symptoms of fatigue, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes are concerning for a serious condition. To start our workup, are you experiencing any difficulty swallowing or shortness of breath?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That weight loss of twelve pounds is significant. Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as constipation or diarrhea, or any blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma.

The combination of significant weight loss, drenching night sweats, fatigue, and a painless, fixed supraclavicular lymph node is highly suspicious for lymphoma. I am requesting a CT scan of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis to visualize lymphadenopathy and abdominal involvement.
